caption: Did Hannah predict Jesus as God’s anointed king? Her song genuinely anticipates Israel’s monarchy—but “anointed” describes Saul and David too.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Hannah predict Jesus? Hannah says God will strengthen His king and exalt His anointed. Christians connect that royal hope with Jesus.
slides.body: Hannah says God will strengthen His king and exalt His anointed. Christians connect that royal hope with Jesus.
slides.heading: Did Hannah predict Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of 1Sam 2:10: He will exalt the horn of His anointed.
slides.body: He will exalt the horn of His anointed.
slides.heading: 1Sam 2:10

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Matt 28:18, BSB: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
slides.body: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Matt 28:18

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: This really is future royal hope Israel has no king yet in the story. The song looks ahead to a ruler empowered by God, and Jesus is later called king.
slides.body: Israel has no king yet in the story. The song looks ahead to a ruler empowered by God, and Jesus is later called king.
slides.heading: This really is future royal hope

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But “anointed” is not unique Saul and David are also God’s anointed kings. These New Testament verses do not mention Hannah’s song.
slides.body: Saul and David are also God’s anointed kings. These New Testament verses do not mention Hannah’s song.
slides.heading: But “anointed” is not unique

title: Hannah's anointed king
